assets.prompt: Create ONE production website asset: a single horizontal sprite strip, precisely SIX equally sized square cells in one row, total aspect ratio 6:1. Each cell has a clean pure white background with generous empty margins. Photorealistic studio catalogue product illustration, crisp edges, soft restrained contact shadow, front three-quarter views. Left to right EXACTLY: (1) one dark blue photovoltaic solar panel with silver frame leaning slightly, (2) one light grey wall-mounted solar inverter with small dark display, (3) one grey solar storage battery with dark top, (4) one solar water heater with cylindrical silver tank and sloping dark blue collector, (5) one bare aluminium solar panel mounting support frame with sloping rails, (6) a coiled red and black electrical cable beside two small solar connectors. Keep each complete object isolated INSIDE its own equally sized square cell; no overlapping or crossing cells, all items centered with 15 percent whitespace margin. These are generic educational category illustrations, not specific brands or products. No text, no labels, no logos, no people, no watermarks, no borders, no decorative solar landscapes. Realistic hardware materials. All six cells must share identical white background and lighting. This is an asset sprite, not a webpage or UI mockup.
